Disabling capture_svg still produces content; SVG is not extracted as an image

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10" fill="red"/></svg>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"capture_svg":false,"extract_images":true}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
